model.description: 16 browser gates navigate LIVE prod but do NOT positively self-assert served==committed (no served-hash / /api/config version check) — they RELY on the network-first service-worker backstop rather than proving the deploy themselves. NOT a false-green (sw.js is network-first for navigations/shell/dist, cache-first only for immutable hashed static; proven live r3014-network-first-gate GREEN DET-3x @0.8.91) — a lower-grade 'doesn't self-prove the deploy' debt. Remediation (cheap, when-touched, NOT a last-mile campaign): add the served==committed guard (/api/config {cache:no-store} + served bundle-hash, the r3014/r403b pattern) or neutralise the SW, each time a gate is next re-run for its own reason. Full 16-gate list + risk-rank durable at scrum.pmo/sw-cache-gate-debt-2026-08-12.md.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Each of the 16 browser gates positively self-asserts served==committed (served bundle-hash / /api/config {cache:no-store} version check), rather than relying on the network-first SW backstop to deliver fresh content — the gate proves the DEPLOY, not just the cache.

This is NOT a false-green: sw.js is network-first for navigations/shell/dist (cache-first only for immutable hashed static = which IS the deploy); proven live r3014-network-first-gate GREEN DET-3x @0.8.91. Lower-grade 'doesn't self-prove the deploy' debt, not a cache-blind false-green.

r3014-network-first-gate is the STANDING REGRESSION-LOCK on the SW backstop: if the SW regresses to cache-first, r3014 goes RED. The debt's containment holds while r3014 is green (r3014 EXCLUDED from the 16 — it self-asserts the served hash, safe-by-design).

Remediation is WHEN-TOUCHED (cheap, not a last-mile campaign): when any of the 16 gates is next re-run for its own reason, add the served==committed guard (r3014/r403b pattern) or neutralise the SW. Do NOT mass-re-run 16 old gates during the campaign — the network-first backstop covers them.

The full 16-gate list + risk-rank (higher=user-facing visual: drawer/vcard/lobby/file-detail/audio/task-detail/detail-chain/newtab...; lower=federation/non-visual: federated-dnd/counterpart-enrichment) is durable at scrum.pmo/sw-cache-gate-debt-2026-08-12.md — this req makes it a tracked backlog item, not memory.
